name: Web server: Probe of a sensitive path
description: A request for a file or page attackers look for: .env, .git, backups, wp-admin, phpMyAdmin, actuator and similar, in the nginx / Apache / OpenResty / lighttpd / Traefik access log in the common or combined format of a container (image nginx, httpd, traefik, caddy, ...). The source is the client address the log names (X-Forwarded-For: its last address, what the outer proxy saw; the rest is client-controlled).
